name: Wall Street
hook: The street, the crash of 1929, and the movie that made "greed is good" famous.

facts.label: New York Stock Exchange
facts.statement: The New York Stock Exchange, founded in 1792, is the Wall Street body where Muriel Siebert became the first woman to hold a seat.

facts.label: Black Thursday
facts.statement: Black Thursday, October 24, 1929, kicked off the Wall Street crash that led to the Great Depression.

facts.label: Wall Street (1987 film)
facts.statement: Oliver Stone's 1987 film Wall Street has Michael Douglas as Gordon Gekko, whose "greed is good" speech won Douglas the Best Actor Oscar.

facts.label: the 99%
facts.statement: Occupy Wall Street popularized the phrase "We are the 99%" to protest economic inequality.

facts.label: Wall Street Journal
facts.statement: The Wall Street Journal is the financial newspaper named for the street; "journal" is a synonym for newspaper.

facts.label: Goldman Sachs
facts.statement: Goldman Sachs, the Wall Street banking powerhouse, is named for founders Marcus Goldman and Samuel Sachs.

facts.label: Michael Bloomberg
facts.statement: Michael Bloomberg's company began by selling computer terminals to Wall Street, and he later became mayor of New York City.
